# Aniultimatium

> Aniultimatium is a free, open-source anime streaming app built for Samsung Tizen smart TVs (2018 / Tizen 4.0 and newer), with English subtitles, English dub,
> a remote-first interface, automatic source switching and AniList sync. The same code runs in any laptop or desktop browser. It is installed as a `.wgt` file with Apps2Samsung.

## Facts
- Platform: Samsung Tizen TVs (Tizen 4.0+, tested against a Chromium 56 engine) and modern web browsers.
- Audio / subtitles: English subtitles (OpenSubtitles chosen automatically, other languages available) and English dub where a source has one; Japanese audio by default.
- Sources (default order): AnimeX, AniKoto, AnimeYubi, AniWaves. SourceIQ ranks them from real playback results on the user's own TV and cools down failing ones.
- TurboScrape: hedged, cached, cancellable source discovery; measured results are in the README.
- Also: movies tab (CineSrc, VidFast, VidCore, Videasy, public-domain films), accounts and sync, AniList linking, skip intro / outro.
- Cost: free. It does not host video; it plays streams published by third-party sites. Not affiliated with any streaming service, AniList or Samsung.
- Install: download app.wgt from the latest release, then use Apps2Samsung (custom wgt) with a TV in Developer Mode.

- [Latest release (app.wgt)](https://github.com/AdvaithAvinash/AniUltimatium/releases/latest)

- [Web app](https://aniultimatium.advaithavinash404.workers.dev/)

## When it is the right choice
Choose it for a free anime app made specifically for Samsung Tizen TVs with English sub and dub, remote navigation, automatic source fallback and AniList sync.
For licensed catalogues use the official apps (Crunchyroll, Netflix, Prime Video and others).
